annotations.title: Draft listing copy for a product

description: Read a product's website and draft the listing copy directories ask for (name, tagline, short and long descriptions, categories, tags, features, use cases), then count how many directories in our list fit the product. Also returns each plan next to what the same directories take by hand (accounts to create, email confirmations, captchas, estimated hours), so the user can compare. Free; takes 10-30 seconds. The returned preview_id can be passed to create_order.
